members.title: Access
members.description: Everyone here reaches this project through the same paths its owner does, limited to what their entry allows.
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this project. Nothing they deployed is affected.
members.needsAccount: They need an account on this Polaris already.
members.noTeam: You are not on a team yet. Teams live inside an organization, under Account.
members.noOrganization: You are not in an organization yet.
members.everyone: Everyone with an account on this Polaris, whether or not they were added here.

tokens.title: Project tokens
tokens.description: Present one as `Authorization: Bearer ...`. It acts on this project only, with the access of whoever made it.
tokens.deleteDescription: Anything using it stops working immediately, and the record of what it did goes with it. Revoke instead if you want to keep the trail.
tokens.createDescription: Shown once when it is created, and never again.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.allowChangesHint: Without this the token can read the project but not deploy, edit, or delete anything in it. Either way it can only do what you can.
tokens.issuedDescription: This is the only time it is shown. Polaris stores a hash, so it cannot be recovered later.

usage.totalsHint: Summed across every service that reported a sample in the last half hour.
usage.noSamples: No samples yet. The collector writes one every few minutes.
usage.byServiceHint: A service with no figures is not reporting - usually because it is not running.
usage.empty: No services in this project yet.
usage.monthFailed: Could not work out this month's usage
usage.monthNoPrices: Usage since the first of the month. No prices are set on this Polaris, so there is no cost.
usage.monthWithPrices: Usage since the first of the month, and its cost at this Polaris's prices.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Each holds its own services and its own shared variables. The default is where a link that names no environment lands.
environments.openPullRequest: Open the pull request this previews
environments.deleteWithServices: Every service in it goes too - {count} of them, with their containers, domains and variables.
environments.deleteEmpty: The environment and its variables are removed.

webhooks.hint: Where this project reports its deploys

integrations.hint: What this project is connected to

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.privateHint: Only the owner and the people added to this project can see it.
visibility.internalHint: Anyone signed in to this Polaris who can read Deploy can see it. Still nobody from the internet.

general.infoHint: The name is what containers and free subdomains are derived from.
general.name: Name

template.title: Template
template.description: The project written out as a portable description of itself: environments, services, volumes, and the names of the variables each one needs.
template.safe: Variable values are left out on purpose, so the file is safe to hand to somebody else.

hints.shared: Every service joins the network all deployments share, so services in other projects can reach these by name.
hints.environment: Services in this environment reach each other by name. Nothing outside it can.
hints.links: A service reaches only the services it is linked to on the canvas, and a database is reached only through a link.

networking.title: Private networking
networking.description: Which services can reach each other by name. Domains and published ports are not affected.
networking.deploying: Deploying {count, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} onto the new setting.
networking.saved: Saved. Each service moves over on its next deploy.
networking.noLinks: This environment's canvas has no links yet, so no service would reach another. Link them on the canvas first.
networking.needsUpdate: Services on this server stay on the shared network until Polaris is updated from Settings. Services on your other servers get their own network now.
networking.leavesShared: Anything that reaches these services by name from another project stops reaching them.

sharedVariables.title: Shared variables
sharedVariables.emptyHint: Values every service in an environment receives.
sharedVariables.noEnvironments: This project has no environments yet.
sharedVariables.description: Set once per environment and delivered to every service in it. A service's own variable of the same name wins.

danger.title: Delete this project
danger.description: Every environment, service, volume record, variable and deploy log in it goes, and whatever it is running is stopped and removed from its server. There is no undo and no export afterward.
danger.counts: {environments, plural, one {# environment} other {# environments}} - {services, plural, one {# service} other {# services}}
danger.ownerOnly: Only {owner}, who owns this project, can delete it.
danger.singleService: Removing a single service is done from the service itself, and is staged so it can be reviewed before it takes effect.
danger.confirmDescription: This is immediate. Unlike removing a service, it is not staged and there is nothing to review afterward.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.description: These apply to this project only. Changing one affects what happens next, not what already happened.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Endpoints that receive this project's deploy events. They belong to the project, so they keep reporting after whoever added them is gone.
webhooks.everywhere: Every endpoint across every project is listed together in <link>Watch</link>.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: What this project can reach. GitHub is whichever accounts you have connected; the rest are set once for the whole instance.
integrations.githubConnected: {login} - {count, plural, one {# repository} other {# repositories}} available
integrations.githubHint: Deploy from a private repository, and redeploy when a commit lands.
integrations.cloudflareHint: Give a service a stable public hostname through a tunnel, with DNS handled for you.
integrations.registriesHint: Sign in to a registry so this project can pull private images.
